subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw core add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload flow, and what storage, validation, auth scope, and identity-precedence contract should it use?
rationale: This is a new product capability and security boundary rather than a broken existing contract, so automation should not choose the upload and persistence policy on its own.

options.title: Approve bounded core upload
options.body: Add a narrow `operator.admin` avatar upload route that validates image bytes, writes a canonical workspace avatar artifact, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps existing avatar read protections.

options.title: Keep current manual/browser-local paths
options.body: Continue supporting configured avatars, `IDENTITY.md`, and browser-local overrides without adding a server-side upload surface for now.

options.title: Resolve rendering reliability first
options.body: Prioritize the adjacent broken-avatar rendering issue before adding a new upload workflow that depends on the same serving path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded core upload
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `operator.admin` avatar upload route that validates image bytes, writes a canonical workspace avatar artifact, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps existing avatar read protections.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history across avatar support merge decisions and current avatar security hardening, which is the central product/security boundary here.
